title: Watch Nashville fans lay flowers in tribute
originalTitle: Watch Nashville fans lay flowers in tribute
content:
The BBC's Helena Humphrey visited the Country Music Hall of Fame in Nashville, Tennessee, on Tuesday evening as fans gathered to mourn Dolly Parton. The country music star died at the age 80 after a brief battle with cancer, her team announced.
